purpose: Confirm whether temporal event/order evidence improves prediction of a perturbation-sensitive insulin signaling response after its development on the known-insulin monitor.

analysis_contract.production_mutation_policy: event_order_is_additive_only; canonical Wave, TMM, and ranking remain unchanged
analysis_contract.temporal_event_interpretation: observed event timing with censoring and replicate bootstrap CI; not kinase attribution, direct regulation, propagation, or causality

pre_omics_qc: pMEK_total_MEK assay when coverage is adequate
cell-health/viability pilot across the chosen dose and time range

chemical_holdout.condition: all code, configuration, event definition, endpoint, and threshold decisions are frozen after primary analysis and before this cohort is unblinded

site_level_primary.name: insulin_specific_inhibitor_interaction
site_level_primary.direction: pre-specified per analyte at analysis time from the interaction estimate; no source-target causal interpretation

temporal_event_primary.name: replicate_aware_event_time_availability
criteria: each required timepoint has at least two finite biological replicate values for bootstrap CI
resolved bootstrap fraction meets temporal_event_order.v1 frozen threshold
left/right censoring is retained rather than converted to a precise time

method_comparison.positive_set: site-level primary interaction outcome within the primary cohort
reporting: calibration curve and Brier score when probabilities are emitted
coverage, numerator, denominator, and no-call rate
comparison_groups: SnapKin where mapping and output are comparable
prohibited: ranking methods without matching their native output family

time_order_tests.site_event_layer: Event times are descriptive until replicate-aware uncertainty is available.
time_order_tests.relation_layer: A source-target temporal order test must name the relation universe before outcomes are examined and use an order-sensitive statistic, not transition_resolution.

null_policy.full_time_index_permutation: Use only for the declared question that observed adjacent order differs from arbitrary common index order; enumerate exactly where computationally feasible.
null_policy.reversal: Report as a directional sensitivity analysis, not a null distribution.
null_policy.adjacent_swap: Report local timing sensitivity by swap; do not convert to a general p-value.
null_policy.circular_or_block_permutation: Do not use with this 7-point irregular-minute design unless a separate, justified stationarity assumption and pre-specified null are documented.

time_order_tests.dynamic_transition_resolution: Retained only as a same-static-Wave local reorganization descriptor. It is not the time-order endpoint.

freezing_and_leakage_controls.reporting_boundary: RAG/LLM may consume only post-analysis numerical evidence plus permitted ChromaDB context. It cannot influence ranking, validation outcome, or truth assignment.

decision_rules.advance_to_holdout: Primary cohort passes target engagement/health QC and all locked technical regression checks; no post-outcome alteration of the event/order contract.
decision_rules.confirmatory_support: Mirdametinib reproduces the pre-specified effect direction and method-level performance/correlation within reported uncertainty. This supports perturbation consistency, not direct kinase-substrate causality.
decision_rules.nonconfirmation: Report compound-specific or non-replicated result, preserve all artifacts, and do not relabel the candidate as validated.
